title: The moral authority of ChatGPT
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures the influence of ChatGPT's moral advice on human judgment in the context of the secular ethical 'trolley problem' dilemma.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its key findings are that ChatGPT provides inconsistent moral advice, this advice influences users' moral judgments even when they know it's from a bot, and users underestimate this influence.
